title: AI Canvas
description_en: A design system for AI agents to design badass interfaces. No more AI slop. AI Canvas gives your AI agent a real design system to build with. The Andromeda Pro AI Brain tells it which tokens and patterns to use, and its done-gate fails work that drifts off the system. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.

title: Every Signal

Every Signal's research agents take a company and a question and return a sourced teardown: traffic, ads, tracking stack, pricing, revenue math, competitors and rules. Every figure is tagged verified, estimate, inferred or rumour. Then it watches for changes.

title: Alfred 6

Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

title: Tecla
description_en: A proactive AI agent whose interface is a TODO list. Tecla is a proactive AI assistant for work. It finds everything that's on your plate and turns it into a curated TODO list. You can click any item and Tecla does it for you. No prompts and no more text threads. You will never leave anything behind again. Just chat with people on Slack, exchange emails, have meetings, and tecla will understand what has to be done from those and surface the work, with all the required context.

title: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7
description_en: Speech-to-Text for live calls, voice agents, and recordings. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is a family of three Speech-to-Text models, one for each kind of audio. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime is for live meetings and calls, with speaker labels as people talk. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime-Agent is for voice agents. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is for recorded audio. All three cover 32 languages.

title: Play That Back
description_en: A pro camera built for iPhone Duo. Play That Back is a pro camera designed around the fold. Frame and control your shot inside while the person you're filming sees the live picture and chooses their look outside. And on Mac, turn Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, photos, and AI videos into Recipes, compare your takes, and build your own looks.
